content.what_it_is: MATLAB input-generator for the FUNWAVE-TVD vessel_island_beach case: builds the depth grid and a circling-vessel track file. Grid: 500x500 cells at dx=dy=2.0 centered on the origin (L3-L11). Bathymetry (L13-L32): base depth 10.0 (L18); outside radius R1=450 the depth shoals as 10.0-(r-R1)*Slope (beach ring, Slope=0.24, L23-L25); inside R2=100 an island rises as 10.0-(R2-r)*Slope_is (Slope_is=0.24, L26-L28); land is capped at -2.0 m elevation via dep(dep<-2.0)=-2.0 (L32). It previews with pcolor(X,Y,-dep) (L35). Vessel track (L37-L60): starting radius Rs=R2-40.0=60, speed0=10.0, target radius Rship=250, spin-up time t0=50; for t=0..300 s the radius ramps linearly from Rs to Rship until t0 then stays at Rship (L50-L54), angular rate omega=speed0/Rship (L55), positions xship=rship*cos(angle), yship=rship*sin(angle) (L56-L58), and actual speed actsp from successive positions (L59). The track is overlaid on the preview (L62-L63). Output: vessel matrix columns (t, xship+m/2*dx, yship+n/2*dy) — coordinates shifted to the model's corner origin (L65-L67; the actsp column is commented out at L68) — then save -ASCII depth.txt dep and save -ASCII vessel_0001 vessel (L70-L71).
entities: script (no function declaration; top-level MATLAB script)
j, i — grid loop indices (L20, L21)
xship, yship — vessel track coordinates (L43-L44, L57-L58)
actsp — actual speed from finite differences (L46, L59)

unresolved: During spin-up the angle uses omega=speed0/Rship while the radius is still rship<Rship (L50-L56), so the actual speed actsp is below speed0 until t0; actsp is computed (L59) but its output column is commented out (L68), leaving the discrepancy unrecorded in vessel_0001.
The vessel file format (header-less 3-column t,x,y named vessel_0001) must match what the FUNWAVE-TVD vessel module expects; the reader-side contract is not in this file.
xship/yship use the domain-centered coordinates and are shifted by +m/2*dx, +n/2*dy on output (L66-L67), implicitly assuming the model origin is the lower-left corner; not verifiable here.
Despite living in postprocessing/, this is an input-preparation script (writes depth.txt and vessel_0001).
Double semicolons at L66-L67 are typos without functional effect.
